children: Tomorrow's weekly report from the EIA is expected to show an increase in the average daily production of ethanol in the U.S., according to analysts surveyed by Dow Jones. They forecast that average production may land anywhere from 1.065 million barrels a day to 1.095 million barrels a day. That's versus 1.053 million barrels a day reported by the EIA last week. The report is being released tomorrow, a day late due to the Columbus Day/Indigenous Peoples' Day holiday observed this past Monday. Most active corn futures on the CBOT are down 0.7%. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
